caption: The video captures a dance rehearsal room with a wall-to-wall mirror, overhead fluorescent panels, and a ballet barre along the left wall. In the foreground a woman in a blue-grey sheer top and beige wide-leg trousers performs a slow arm-and-hand sequence, seen from the side, the figure facing the camera being her mirror reflection. Her hands start drawn near her face, one cupped by the mouth, then gather at the chest. One hand opens palm-up forward while the other rises, and her right arm lifts to a high overhead position. That arm then sweeps outward and across as her torso rotates so her back turns more toward the camera. Her legs shift from a closed stance into a wide lunged stance, and one foot lifts near the final frame. The mirror reflection tracks these changes, while reflected participants in white tops and grey trousers and one in black move their arms from bent positions near the head toward overhead reaches. Ceiling lights, mirror seams and the barre keep constant positions, indicating a stationary camera.
